# Ryle Anthony Gabotero

> Evidence-backed portfolio of a software engineer in the Negros Island Region, Philippines, working across backend systems, cybersecurity, applied AI, and data engineering.

Ryle Anthony Gabotero builds full-stack systems, security tooling, computer-vision pipelines, and real-time applications. The portfolio connects technical claims to source repositories, demonstrations, competition records, credentials, and visual evidence.

## Portfolio

- [Profile](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/): Professional overview, engineering focus, technical toolkit, and supporting evidence.
- [Projects](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects): Software engineering case studies with architecture, technology choices, repositories, and project status.
- [Experience and credentials](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/experience): Cybersecurity competitions, technical programs, assessments, and documented results.
- [Activity gallery](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/gallery): Photographs, certificates, and supporting records for competitions and training.
- [Contact](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/contact): Professional contact channels, availability, location, and résumé.

## Selected project case studies

- [SafeView](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects/safeview): Local visual-phishing detection using OCR and semantic embeddings.
- [OvaLens Ecosystem](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects/ovalens): YOLOv8 duck-egg classification connected to an ESP32 conveyor workflow.
- [HLS Proxy Server](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects/proxy-server): Node.js streaming relay with manifest rewriting, range requests, backpressure, caching, and private-network safeguards.
- [myAnime](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects/myanime): Retired streaming application architecture built around a reverse proxy, Redis, and PostgreSQL.
- [AR Chronicle](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects/archronicle): Android and Unity AR exploration using ARCore SLAM and OpenStreetMap geofencing.
- [Pickle World](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects/pickleworld): Retired real-time venue booking system with WebSocket locks and transactional payment reconciliation.
